name: codex-usage
description: Show the shared ChatGPT and Codex quota in the macOS menu bar or Windows system tray.

interface.shortDescription: Live ChatGPT and Codex quota in your system status area.
interface.longDescription: Install, configure, and troubleshoot the Codex Usage menu-bar and system-tray app. It shows the remaining shared ChatGPT and Codex weekly quota and can notify you at configurable thresholds.
interface.defaultPrompt: Install Codex Usage and verify that my shared ChatGPT and Codex weekly quota appears in the system status area.
